name: Pristine
description: Surfaces that are flawless, without any signs of wear, scratches, or damage. They appear brand new and untouched.

name: Excellent
description: Surfaces that show minimal signs of wear, with only very minor scratches or blemishes that are hardly noticeable.

name: Very Good
description: Surfaces that have been gently used and show some signs of wear, such as light scratches or scuffs, but are still well-maintained.

name: Good
description: Surfaces that show moderate signs of wear, including visible scratches, scuffs, or small dents, but are still in decent condition.

name: Fair
description: Surfaces that have noticeable signs of wear and may have scratches, dents, or other damage that affects their appearance but doesn't impair their functionality.

name: Poor
description: Surfaces that are heavily worn, damaged, or marked with significant scratches, dents, or other defects that greatly affect their appearance and usability.

name: Damaged
description: Surfaces that are severely damaged or broken, making them unusable or in need of extensive repair.
